description: Canonical feature contract shared by the Swift FeatureEncoder (inference) and the Python trainer. If these two drift, accuracy silently collapses. This file is the single source of truth; both sides must match it. v2: coords_per_point 2 -> 3 (x, y, z). Depth is real for ARKit hand tracking and 0 for 2D camera sources.

normalization.scale: euclidean distance between body point 0 and body point 1

continuous.description: Level-3 CTC path: variable-ish length context of frames -> per-timestep logits over vocab + blank. Consumed by the Swift ContinuousSignRecognizer and produced by training/model_ctc.py.
